notes:
LRT Jakarta Phase 1 "Lin Selatan" (Line S/Line 1), operated by PT LRT Jakarta under PT Jakarta Propertindo (Jakpro). 6 stations in order Pegangsaan Dua (Kelapa Gading) -> Boulevard Utara (Summarecon) -> Boulevard Selatan -> Pulomas -> Equestrian -> Velodrome, ~5.8 km, end-to-end ~13-15 min. Service daily ~05:30-23:00 WIB, headway ~10 min (first NB from Pegangsaan Dua 05:30; first SB from Velodrome 05:50). route_type=0 (light rail/tram) chosen as best GTFS fit for LRT. The Manggarai extension (Phase 2) is under construction and NOT yet operational, so it is intentionally excluded (no evidenced stops/times).

Stop coordinates from per-station Wikipedia pages. Order confirmed via OSM route relation 10693161 and Wikipedia adjacency. Schedule times from lrtjakarta.co.id/jadwal.html (via aggregated official-cited data; the page itself returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch) and Moovit. Per-stop travel offsets are approximate (2-3 min/segment) derived from published first/last per-station departure times; only one representative trip per direction is provided (a full ~10-min-headway timetable can be generated by cloning at 10-min intervals from 05:30 to ~22:00).
